events.verdict: Herro (MIA) has a hand placed on Washington's (DAL) side and the contact does not affect his dunk.
Irving (DAL) absorbs the contact created by Herro (MIA) as he leans into him prior to his shot attempt.
Washington (DAL) briefly applies a forearm to Adebayo's (MIA) body, which he moves through off ball.
Herro (MIA) has an arm placed against Marshall's (DAL) front during the pick, which he removes immediately.
Lively II (DAL) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact from Butler (MIA) contesting his driving shot attempt.
Lively II (DAL) firms up in a screening position in Burks' (MIA) path and does not deliver contact.
Dinwiddie (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Herro's (MIA) drive to the basket and then cleanly blocks his shot attempt.
Larsson (MIA) moves alongside Irving's (DAL) path and maintains legal guarding position defending his drive to the basket.
Adebayo (MIA) intentionally kicks the ball.
Adebayo (MIA) and Lively II (DAL) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Irving (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it away from Butler (MIA) and the ensuing contact is incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Adebayo's (MIA) leg is out of bounds when he contacts the ball and Dallas correctly retains possession.
Larsson (MIA) reaches across Irving's (DAL) front and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.
Butler (MIA) commits a take foul on Irving (DAL).
Dinwiddie (DAL) commits a take foul on Herro (MIA).
Lively II (DAL) grazes the ball during the contest and the ensuing contact does not affect Butler's (MIA) dunk attempt.
Dinwiddie (DAL) briefly grasps and releases Butler's (MIA) jersey during his drive.
Butler (MIA) legally contests Dinwiddie's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) has an arm placed around Lively II (DAL) but he releases and does not affect his ability to pursue the rebound.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself in Washington's (DAL) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.
Lively II (DAL) moves alongside of Butler's (MIA) path during his drive to the basket and the contact with Butler's (MIA) arm during the shot attempt is marginal.
Butler (MIA) places his off-arm against Thompson (DAL) and releases as he comes to a stop.
Thompson (DAL) maintains a collapsed forearm against Butler's (MIA) side during his shot attempt.
Irving (DAL) engages with Larsson (MIA) underneath the rim and although Larsson is off-balance, he is not dislodged from his rebounding position.
Dinwiddie (DAL) briefly grasps and releases Adebayo's (MIA) jersey while the ball is loose.
Butler (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during Irving's (DAL) drive to the basket.
Lively II (DAL) establishes himself in Butler's (MIA) path and absorbs the contact as the two come together during the pick.
Larsson (MIA) places a forearm against Dinwiddie's (DAL) back during the rebound when Dinwiddie is already off-balance.
Dinwiddie (DAL) commits a take foul on Larsson (MIA).
Irving (DAL) commits a take foul on Burks (MIA).
Butler (MIA) and Dinwiddie (DAL) engage and disengage off ball.
